title: Reservation Capacity-Source Latest-Recorded Selection Validation
objective: Validate whether the exact capacity-source revisions already resolved by canonical FOOD-007F equal the highest structurally valid recorded revisions individually observed through the public FOOD-007G and FOOD-007H latest-recorded readers.
dependencies: FOOD-007E exact reservation capacity-source selection request
FOOD-007F exact reservation capacity-source selection resolution
FOOD-007G public exact-SKU latest-recorded capacity-source read
FOOD-007H public exact fulfillment-slot latest-recorded capacity-source read

inputBoundary.database: One injected database structurally satisfying the existing exact-SKU and exact-slot read contracts.
inputBoundary.capture: The relevant resolution identities and selected revisions are synchronously captured and validated before the first awaited database read.
inputBoundary.binding: The resolved SKU-source identities/revisions and resolved slot-source identity/revision must agree with the selection embedded by FOOD-007F.

algorithm: Capture and validate the FOOD-007F resolution shape and its exact selection/source bindings.
For each SKU selection in original demand order, invoke FOOD-007G for that exact SKU stream.
If the returned highest recorded revision equals the selected revision, preserve one detached observation and continue.
If the returned revision is greater than the selected revision, stop with later-recorded-revision.
If the returned revision is lower than the selected revision, fail closed as storage-failure because the observed latest-recorded stream contradicts the canonical previously resolved exact revision.
After all SKU checks succeed, invoke FOOD-007H for the exact selected fulfillment-slot stream.
Apply the same equality, later-recorded-revision and lower-than-selected fail-closed rules.
Return validated only when every individual read observed the selected revision as that stream's highest structurally valid recorded revision.

outcomes.validated: Every selected revision equaled the highest structurally valid recorded revision returned for its exact stream at that stream's individual read point.
outcomes.later-recorded-revision: At least one exact stream returned a structurally valid recorded revision greater than the selected revision. This reports only the observed revision relationship and does not establish governing authority.
outcomes.not-found: A latest-recorded reader returned not-found for a selected exact stream. This is not physical-stock absence and is not reservation authority.
outcomes.invalid: The supplied FOOD-007F resolution is malformed, internally misbound, or produces an invalid selector at the public latest-recorded reader boundary.
outcomes.storage-failure: A public reader reports storage-failure or a highest-recorded revision lower than a previously resolved selected revision is observed.

ordering.skuReads: Sequential in original FOOD-007E demand order.
ordering.slotRead: Runs only after every SKU selection passes.
ordering.failure: Fail fast on the first nonmatching, missing, invalid or failed stream.

concurrency.statement: Sequential reads do not establish a simultaneous database snapshot. A later revision may be appended before, between or immediately after reads.
concurrency.validatedMeaning: Validated means only that each individual read returned the selected revision as that stream's highest structurally valid recorded revision at that reader's own observation point.

reservationBoundary: FOOD-007I does not read food_capacity_reservations, food_capacity_reservation_lines or food_fulfillment_slot_reservations.
sideEffects: Read-only server-library composition. No writes, routes, clocks, network calls beyond the injected database abstraction, environment access, randomness, acceptance construction or migration execution.
safeClaim: At each individual latest-recorded read performed by this validation, the selected revision equaled the structurally valid highest-recorded revision returned for that exact stream.
migration: None. Migration 0005 must not be executed.
